Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the War Memorials Online entry that listed only WWI and then incorrectly concluded that the “over 60 million casualties” figure referred to World War I. This ignored earlier evidence that the memorial commemorates both WWI and WWII and the well-established fact that 60+ million casualties corresponds to World War II. The error arose from over-reliance on a single, incomplete source, failure to reconcile conflicting sources (e.g., Wikipedia, IWM), and conflating participation/mobilization figures with casualties.
